items.summary: Life Sciences, Energy, Sports Entertainment, and Environmental Liability offerings mark the next phase of Ategrity’s profitable growth strategy Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings (NYSE:ASIC) today announced the launch of four new specialty products for small and medium-sized businesses: Life Sciences, Energy, Sports Entertainment, and Environmental Liability. items.title: Ategrity Expands Suite of Pre-Priced Solutions with Launch of Religious Organizations Offering
items.summary: Unlocks Growth Potential of Over 200,000 Institutions Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings (NYSE: ASIC) today announced the launch of Ategrity Select Religious Organizations, the latest addition to its pre-priced platform. The company has pre-qualified and pre-priced more than 200,000 religious institutions across the United States for comprehensive property and casualty coverage.
